# Michael Hawi Onyango

> AI engineer specialising in SEO and GEO (generative engine optimisation): helping brands get found in Google and cited in AI answers, and building the data pipelines and AI tools behind it. Currently at Petplan España. BSc Applied Computer Technology, USIU-Africa (2026).

## The NSE in Python (data series on the Nairobi Securities Exchange, 2013–2025)
- [Part 1: How to get NSE stock data into Python, free](https://michael-hawi-onyango-portfolio.onrender.com/blog/nse-historical-data-python/): free daily NSE prices 2013–2025, loading and cleaning in pandas, data errors fixed, Safaricom price history
- [Part 2: How the Nairobi Securities Exchange performed from 2013 to 2025](https://michael-hawi-onyango-portfolio.onrender.com/blog/nse-2013-2025-in-one-chart/): annual NSE All Share Index and NSE-20 returns, the 2018–2023 drawdown, shilling vs dollar returns
- [Dataset: NSE month-end index levels and Safaricom price, 2013–2025 (CSV, CC BY 4.0)](https://michael-hawi-onyango-portfolio.onrender.com/blog/nse-python/nse-month-end-2013-2025.csv)
